# E18 (2/2): NO-GO alignment — full inventory classification

**Input**: `scripts/E18_nogo_inventory.txt` (84 documents, generated by `scripts/E18_nogo_inventory.py`, read-only, not re-run).
**Method**: identical to `docs/E18-NOGO-ALIGNMENT.md` — for each document extract the central negative
proposition (one statement of the form "X cannot be done / Y does not exist / route Z is closed"), then assign
**one** category from internal evidence only:
`KNOWN-TO-FRONTIER` (the doc states, or its own citations show, that the proposition is / follows from a published result of others) ·
`OURS-ALONE` (a mechanism or obstruction the project identified and attributes to no one else) ·
`SUPERSEDED` (a later doc in this repo replaces or corrects this one) ·
`CLOSED-BY-FRONTIER` (the frontier independently established the impossibility or abandoned the route, per the doc) ·
`INTERNAL-ONLY` (bookkeeping / registry / protocol / audit statement needing no external counterpart) ·
`UNCLEAR`.

**Caveat (honest)**: classification rests **only** on each document's own text and the citations it makes.
No fresh literature search was performed. `OURS-ALONE` therefore means **"not attributed to anyone else in the document"**,
**not** "novel" — an uncredited ingredient may still be classical (§4–§5). Empty/incomplete attributions were not upgraded
to `KNOWN-TO-FRONTIER`; where evidence was thin, the item is listed in §4 rather than guessed.

**Relation to part 1**: the 12 rows of `E18-NOGO-ALIGNMENT.md` §1 mostly concern documents *outside* this inventory
(e.g. `phase-locking-guinand.md`, `ALIGN-A2-jensen-polya.md`, `E30-UNIFIED-CONVERSION-LAW.md`, `DOOR5f`, the A1 files).
Only ~7 inventory documents are covered there (moving-edge: `p33*`, `p28-p33-final-archive`, `ARCHIVE-P28-P33`;
TP/PF: `TPX-verdict`, partly `R6`; phase locking: `2026-08-23-full-archive`). To avoid a gap, **all 84 are classified below**;
overlaps are flagged in the evidence column.

**Documents that could not be classified: none.** Every inventory document carries explicit status labels
(`[证明] / [结构性归约] / [FROZEN GAP] / 【引用·经典】 / 【推导】 / 【核验】`) and names its own sources, so the
negative proposition and its attribution are determinable from the document alone. This is *not* a claim that
the classifications are correct — only that they are decidable from internal evidence.

**Reading of the distribution.** The dominant category is `OURS-ALONE` (51/84), but this must not be read as
"51 new results": by construction it means only *"the document attributes the obstruction to no one else."*
A large part of that set is the project's recurring **β-wall / detection≠exclusion / zero-readout-exhaustion**
motif restated on many routes (d7, log-energy, pn, pfe, phase-archive, modulus-rigidity, lemma3b, meta-argument).
Genuinely self-standing mechanisms appear as a minority within it (moving-edge, canonicalization obstruction,
Asano/limit-stability gap in the project's own reading, A′/B′ grammar no-go, factorization no-go).

## §5 Honest residual risks (not a category, noted for the next pass)

*Several `OURS-ALONE` items have **classical-looking ingredients** and could move to KNOWN-TO-FRONTIER after a real
literature check — most likely: `AM-affine-final-verdict` (elementary semigroup argument), `p49-r3-grammar-closed-a-prime`
Theorem B′ (FE quartet symmetry is elementary), `modulus-rigidity-NOGO-archive` (M2 |1−1/ρ|=1 ⟺ Re ρ=½ is the classical
unit-circle identity already flagged in part 1), `H1-two-scales-verdict` (same identity; plus a literature-gap claim),
`pfe-archive` and `character-family-archive` (characters = linearisation / Montgomery attribution),
`contradiction-reductio-boundary` (exclusion of infinitely many off-line zeros is classically derived via λ_n asymptotics).*

*Conversely, `INTERNAL-ONLY` was used for project maps/registries/protocols even where they assert mathematical
claims about the project's own route space (CLOSED-ROUTES-MAP, RH-prior-NOGO-checklist, MASTER-NOGO,
RH-BOUNDARY-MAP-FROZEN-MASTER-TABLE, SCALE-DYNAMICS-FINAL-BOUNDARY-MAP, rh-mechanism-boundary-map,
RH-map-final-archive). Re-classifying those as OURS-ALONE is a defensible alternative reading; the boundary
between "bookkeeping" and "substantive negative claim" is not sharp for this project.*

*The inventory itself was produced by keyword matching on file names (see `E18_nogo_inventory.py`); it therefore
both **includes** documents that are not mainly negative (wallB, wallC, PROTOCOL-*) and **excludes** negative-result
documents without a keyword in the file name (e.g. `DOOR5f-burnol-original-resolves-everything.md`,
`ALIGN-A2-jensen-polya.md`, `ALIGN-A3-weil-positivity-inertia.md`, the A1 files cited in part 1).*
